stem: In a scrapyard near Surat, Ravi uses a lifting electromagnet to move iron sheets. He has lifted an iron sheet and wants to drop it onto a truck. What should he do to release the iron sheet?

options.text: Switch the current ON so the electromagnet holds the sheet more tightly
Switch the current OFF so the magnetic effect stops and the sheet is released
Increase the current so the sheet falls off on its own
Wait, because the electromagnet keeps holding the sheet even without current

teacher.key_rationale: A lifting electromagnet attracts iron only while current flows (ON). To release the iron sheet, the current must be switched OFF so the magnetic effect stops. Options A and C keep or increase the current, so the sheet stays held; D incorrectly claims the magnet holds without current.
